stem: Which quotation from the selection from The Boston Girl best identifies the conflict in the poem “Sybil Ludington’s Ride”?

options.label: A
options.text: I’m telling you, my feet didn’t touch the ground all the way home. (paragraph 5)

options.label: B
options.text: "There is no wrong answer," she said. "I want to know your opinion, Addie. What do you think?" (paragraph 10)

options.label: C
options.text: "The patriots had to be impetuous both ways or they wouldn’t have dared challenge the British." (paragraph 12)

options.label: D
options.text: She said mothers were right to be concerned for their daughters’ welfare. (paragraph 14)
